selection_rule: For each pair, use the first complete independently regradable whole-pair artifact fixed before inspecting its score; retry only technical failures.

attempts.reason: The independent experiment branch omitted the frozen prior-D evidence archive. No model inference or score was produced.
The H/I protocol reader used the older split.cases schema and raised KeyError: cases. No qualifying whole-pair record entered analysis.
Four early pairs failed at model_start because the 9.92 GB Hugging Face download ended with HTTP/2 CANCEL. I3 was the first complete valid I3 pair and was locked into the main analysis.
The download-hardening push triggered the workflow default A/legacy job; it was not an H/I paired experiment.

H3, I1, I2, I3 and H2 produced complete artifacts; H1 reached the 40-minute job limit and was cancelled without an artifact. The duplicate I3 was archived but excluded because the earlier complete I3 was already fixed.
Only the cancelled H1 whole pair was rerun with unchanged settings.
